In Russian, certain verbs are commonly paired with specific prepositions. The choice of preposition can affect the meaning significantly, indicating aspects like direction or the object of thought.

Example:
Думать о (dumat' o): Я думаю о тебе. (I think about you.)
The preposition о indicates the object of thought.
